pages.text: The $(item)stock$() holds what a workstation uses: seed, bone meal, tools, bottles, bait.
The $(item)basket$() takes what it yields. It shows what is in it, which saves opening it.

pages.title: Where They Stand
pages.text: Both must touch the post, or stand in the line of its fence. Several of each are allowed.$(br2)A full basket stops the work. Nothing is ever thrown on the ground. Whoever works the post holds what does not fit, and waits. Empty the basket, or run a hopper from it.
